name: Outback Steakhouse Wood-Fire Grilled Salmon (Plain, Remoulade Withheld)
whyItWorks: Fresh Atlantic salmon grilled over an oak wood fire. Naturally packed with anti-inflammatory marine omega-3 fatty acids that actively soothe mucosal irritation. Tender and easily digested.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: 'Wood-fire grilled salmon plain—NO classic seasoning, NO peppercorn crust, NO remoulade sauce, grilled with salt only.' Pair with plain steamed veggies or baked potato.
